info.title: Hybrid AI-Powered Multilingual Plagiarism Detection API
info.description: Production REST API for multilingual plagiarism detection across English, Hindi, and Telugu.

get.description:
Returns live operational status of backend services and core dependencies:
PostgreSQL database connection, Redis broker connection, and background worker queue.

Verifies that the caller's JWT bearer token is valid and active,
returning the decoded UserPrincipal identity.
Demonstrates RBAC enforcement: accessible only to users with ADMIN role.

schema.title: Response Admin Role Probe Api V1 Auth Admin Probe Get

post.description:
Uploads a document to private storage, validates structural integrity,
and initiates asynchronous text extraction and passage segmentation.

get.description: Lists uploaded documents belonging to the authenticated user.
Retrieves document metadata, page counts, word counts, and extraction status.

delete.summary: Hard Delete Document and Derived Data
delete.description: Permanently deletes document file from private storage, passages, and database records.

get.description: Retrieves raw extracted text and character metrics for UI preview.
Retrieves deterministic passage segments and code-point offsets.

post.description: Creates a new private reference collection for group-based plagiarism analysis.

get.description: Lists reference collections owned by or shared with the authenticated user.
Retrieves metadata and document statistics for a specific reference collection.
Lists all source documents currently indexed within a reference collection.

post.description: Links an existing processed document into a reference collection.

delete.description: Removes a document from a reference collection (does not delete the document itself).

post.summary: Validate Comparison Inputs and Check Phase 3 Readiness
post.description:
Validates selected submission and reference inputs across comparison modes:
- Direct (1:1)
- One-to-Many (1:N)
- Corpus (1:Collection)

Ensures all documents are processed and valid. Does NOT compute similarity (Phase 3 boundary).
